data.long_meaning: Naval is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nava' meaning 'new' and 'alam' meaning 'ocean'. This name signifies the one who is the lord of the waters and the creator of the universe. The name Naval carries the meaning “Lord of the waters” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naval usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the waters and live with faith, good character and purpose.
